about: Open decisions for Dinis, from board/team/holacracy.d/proposals/. holacracy.d@AgentiCCells.dinis, 22 Nov 2026. A pick on the page is a note for you; only your word in my session counts. One set (decisions.d, 22 Nov 21:55Z): these nine are the single list; the proposals in proposals/ are their long form. Statuses below come from Dinis's voice memo (~17:05Z, relayed, board/team/maestro.d/decisions/2026-11-22-voice-memo-18-answers.md) and earlier answers.
